_comment: Prevent Damage (2026-09-27, phase I2). EACH Pyrohemia activation is its own damage event, so
Dina drains once PER ACTIVATION. Board: Pyrohemia, Tamanoa + Dina (both sick; resumed at main 1),
two Mountains, empty hand. The search activates {R} twice (K is a searched axis, the full
1..affordable range). Each activation: 1 to Tamanoa, Dina, us and the opponent = 4 dealt ->
Tamanoa gains 4 -> Dina drains 1. Two activations: us 20 - 2 + 8 = 26, opponent 20 - 2 - 2 = 16.
An implementation that summed the pings into one event would read opponent 17; one that dropped
the gain (or took the generic K cap wrongly) would read otherwise.
